name: Zero-shot BRCA1 'Both' (coding and noncoding) SNVs classification (Evo 2 paper, Supplementary Data 1)
description: Zero-shot classification of loss-of-function (LOF) versus functional or intermediate (FUNC, INT) variants in the BRCA1 'Both' (coding and noncoding) SNVs stratum, AUROC and AUPRC.

attributes.protocol: Score each variant zero-shot (for Evo 2, the log-likelihood of the variant sequence minus that of the reference over an 8,192-bp genomic window around the variant) and compute AUROC and AUPRC for loss-of-function (LOF) versus functional or intermediate (FUNC, INT) variants in the stratum Data 'BRCA1', Genomic_Feature 'Both', Variant_Type 'SNV'.

No uncertainty is reported.

attributes.source_locator: Sheet 'Sheet1', A1:J706
limitations: Variant counts in Supplementary Data 1 differ from the counts in the Fig. 3 legend: ClinVar coding SNVs 14,313 (legend 14,319), noncoding SNVs 33,747 (legend 34,761), coding non-SNVs 978 (legend 1,236), noncoding non-SNVs 3,623 (legend 3,894); SpliceVarDB exonic 1,179 (legend 1,181) and intronic 3,708 (legend 3,769); BRCA1 coding SNVs 2,768 (legend 2,077). BRCA1 noncoding (1,125) and BRCA1 all SNVs (3,893) match the legend and Supplementary Information A.3.15.

The ClinVar rows with Genomic_Feature 'Both' (SNV 89,126; Indel 25,501; Microsatellite 618 variants) are larger than the sum of the coding and noncoding rows (SNV 48,060), so 'Both' is not the union of the coding and noncoding strata; the source does not explain the difference.
Coding Indel (1,150) plus coding Microsatellite (172) rows do not sum to the coding non-SNV row (978); the relation between the 'non-SNV', 'Indel' and 'Microsatellite' strata is not stated.

Sub_category labels 'Poorly conserved' and 'Not conserved' do not match the bin names in Supplementary Information A.3.13 ('weakly conserved', 0 <= phyloP < 0.5; 'accelerated evolution', phyloP < 0); the mapping is not stated.
Model label spelling differs within the sheet: 'phyloP 100/241/447/470' on SpliceVarDB rows and 'PhyloP 100/241/447/470' elsewhere.
AUROC and AUPRC cells store full-precision doubles and carry the number format '0.000', so the workbook displays three decimals.
No uncertainty (confidence interval or standard error) is given for any value.

ClinVar coding SNVs (14,313 against 14,319), SpliceVarDB exonic (1,179 against 1,181) and BRCA1 coding SNVs (2,768 against 2,077) also differ from the legend, but their Supplementary Table 6 to 8 values agree with the workbook and, for BRCA1, 2,768 plus 1,125 noncoding equals the n = 3,893 of Fig. 3f; they are not disputed.
